items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Trombone was Janice Robinson, a gal playing trombone.

ctx.x: -- Bryant, Ray Bryant, and Major Holly, the Mule, on bass, Grady Tate on drums, Mackel, Bill Mackel, who's been with Lionel Hampton for 963 years, on guitar. And in the trumpet section I can't call all the names -- Joe Newman, Doc Cheatham. Oh, my goodness gracious me -- two more other guys.
Trombone was Janice Robinson, a gal playing trombone. You know Janice.
She played with Fletcher a plunger?
